content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

When comparing platforms like Gumroad and a sovereign commerce stack, the differences are stark. Gumroad offers a user-friendly interface for selling digital products but charges a steep 10% fee on every sale. In contrast, a sovereign stack built with COREMERCH tools provides you with complete ownership of your infrastructure. You can accept crypto payments with NOWPayments at only a 0.5% fee, allowing you to retain significantly more revenue. This fundamental difference can drastically affect your bottom line, especially when selling high-ticket items.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Many conventional platforms do not operate in countries facing economic sanctions or regulatory challenges, leaving creators in regions like Zimbabwe or Venezuela without options. COREMERCH's model, however, is designed specifically for these circumstances. With no reliance on traditional banking systems, you can set up your digital store using free tools like GitHub Pages or Google Apps Script. This ensures that your business can continue to operate seamlessly, regardless of geopolitical constraints.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed is critical for digital creators. While platforms like Gumroad can take days to transfer funds due to their payment processing methods, NOWPayments offers instant payment confirmations through crypto, allowing you to deliver products immediately upon sale. Additionally, the cost savings from using NOWPayments over Gumroad are substantial. For 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you would retain $921 more using NOWPayments, highlighting the real financial implications of choosing your selling platform wisely.
Keep 91.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments compared to Gumroad's 90%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a crucial factor when selecting a digital commerce solution. With traditional platforms, you often surrender control over your customer data and payment processes. COREMERCH's offerings, such as the Complete Builder Kit, ensure that you own everything post-deployment. Automated delivery of products via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script adds efficiency to your process. This system not only saves time but also enhances the customer experience, allowing for immediate access to purchased goods, which is essential for maintaining buyer satisfaction.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture for selling digital products hinges on your specific needs and constraints. If you're operating in a restricted environment or want to escape platform fees, the Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal for quick deployment. For more complex needs, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a robust solution with scalability in mind. Ultimately, your choice should reflect your ambition to establish a sustainable and sovereign online store, free from the limitations of conventional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Experience instant product delivery that enhances customer satisfaction.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify the digital products you want to sell and prepare them for online distribution. Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your store. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. Ensure product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the entire system for functionality before launching.
